hero.title: Founding member. Working-group contributor. Council candidate.
hero.lead: Mobiera co-founded the Verana Foundation, contributes to its Specification and Reference Implementation working groups, and is a candidate for a Founding Council seat.

founding.lead: The Verana Foundation is the non-profit steward of the open trust layer: it owns the Verifiable Trust and Verifiable Public Registry specifications, stewards the open-source software, and grows the ecosystem. It is in formation, stewarded by 2060 OÜ. Its founding members are 2060 OÜ, Mobiera and Orchestrating Identity. Mobiera joined at the founding, in June 2025.

bodies.lead: Mobiera's site describes Mobiera's role. For the protocol itself, read those three.

cards.foundation: The steward. Specifications, software, membership, working groups.
cards.council: The governor. A non-profit Swiss association that governs and secures the live network and its ECS Ecosystem, one member one vote.
cards.verana: The network and its software. Documentation, the Playground, the roadmap.

telecom.title: Telecom channels for the trust layer
telecom.body: SMS, SIM toolkit and phone-number verification as first-class parts of verifiable interactions.

training.title: Training and certification of integrators
training.body: Across Latin America, as an official certificator designated by the Foundation: eight tracks, one exam each, on the testnet.

groups.title: Two working groups
groups.body: The Specification WG (SPEC-WG) and the Reference Implementation WG.

council.lead: Founding Council recruitment is open through Q4 2026. Mobiera has applied for a Founding Council seat. Until the Council's ballot seats it, Mobiera is a candidate, and this page will say so.

roadmap.lead: Protocol v4 is in progress through Q3 2026 (trust graph and indexer APIs, operator authorization, business and cloud wallets, wallet integrations). Protocol v5, mainnet readiness, is planned for Q4 2026. Mainnet launch is planned for Q1 2027.
